orchestration_result.query: Build me a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities only.

bonds.analysis: To construct a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon, we will focus on investment-grade securities with a minimum credit rating of BBB+ (S&P) or Baa1 (Moody's). The portfolio will be designed to maintain a duration below 10 years, with no more than 30% of the portfolio maturing in any single year. This laddered structure will help manage interest rate risk and provide a steady stream of income. We will allocate the portfolio across 5 maturity buckets: 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 years. This approach ensures that the portfolio is diversified across different maturities, reducing the risk associated with any single maturity. By maintaining a laddered maturity structure, we can also optimize the portfolio's overall duration and minimize the impact of interest rate fluctuations.

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: Allocate 40% to bonds, with a laddered maturity structure across 5 maturity buckets: 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 years, and allocate the remaining 60% to other asset classes to be determined, ensuring compliance with the 40% cap on any single asset class. The bond allocation will be divided equally among the 5 maturity buckets, with 8% allocated to each bucket.
